selection: Predeclared highest validation macro F1; lower validation loss only for exact ties. Never test selection.

overfitting: mild; selected unaugmented gap2.57pp, temporary epoch9 validation-loss spike, recovered final validation loss and bounded macro-F1 plateau
underfitting: none significant on the internal benchmark; train/validation well above31.26% majority reference
convergence: Stable bounded optimization and configured patience3 macro-F1 stop at11; epoch8winner. No claim of global optimum or completed12epochbudget.
source_risk: Overlapping PlantVillage579 accuracy570/579; Corn-only48 accuracy37/48 and GLS2/9recall. Small, non-independent source subsets with noHealthy in Corn-only.

why_no_extra_classifier_run: Required lineage correction is complete; current training learns strongly and modest probes do not show optimization collapse.
